title: 第一卷 第21章 百年后你风采依旧我已老态龙钟第一卷 第22章 春十三
content_zh:
林罪把这个疑问压下去，微微弯腰，“凌师兄。”
凌玄道点了点头。
林诗涵松开林罪的手，随后从怀里拿出一个布包，塞进林罪怀里，“林哥哥，我已经快突破一骨人仙了，厉不厉害？”
手又重新挽了林罪的胳膊，看起来很开心。
林罪握住她的手腕，把她的手从胳膊上拿了下来。
林诗涵愣了一下。
她以为只是有外人，所以需要保持点距离。
“林哥哥？”
林罪没有看她。
他退后半步，拉开了两人之间的距离。
随后说道，“林师姐，你是内门弟子，殿主传人，而我只是一个杂役弟子，你我之间，确实不该有太多的交往。”
林诗涵站在原地，脸上有些僵硬，笑容缓缓消失。
“你说什么？”她的声音很轻。
林罪没有回答。
从怀里拿出那个布包，打开看了一眼。
里面是几颗丹药，品相比合气丹好了不止一筹，还有几块风干的兽肉，肉干上隐约能看到纹路。
都是好东西。
他把布包重新扎好，递了回去。
“这些资源是宗门用来培养你的，不属于我，不用给我送东西。”
“林哥哥”，林诗涵的声音有些发抖，“你是不是觉得我给你添麻烦了？不要我了？”

林罪摇了摇头，声音很平淡。
“林师姐，以前的回忆，就当做年少无知吧。”
林诗涵的眼眶红了，眼泪在眼眶里滑落，在脸颊上留下一道湿痕。
“你到底怎么了？你还是我认识的林哥哥吗？”
林罪抬起头看她。
她哭了，无比伤心。
在他的印象里，这个小丫头基本没有哭过。
即使在安阳村，被狗追，磕破皮，她都没有哭过。
而现在，让她哭的人是他自己。
林罪心中无比心疼，差一点就伸手去擦她的眼泪了。
但他没有。
他看着她的眼睛，一字一句的说道。
“林师姐，入门半个多月，你就要突破一骨人仙了，你也看到了，我是一骨雏形，修炼半个月连仙骨位置都感觉不到，别人十年破凡，我可能需要二十年，甚至更久。”
“二十年之后，你恐怕已经修到了五骨人仙，甚至逆天改命，诞生更多的仙骨，寿元无数，永葆青春，站到更高的地方去。”
content_en:
Lin Zui suppressed the question and bent slightly, "Senior Brother Ling."
Ling Xuandao nodded.
Lin Shihan let go of Lin Zui's hand, then took out a cloth bag from her arms and stuffed it into Lin Zui's arms, "Brother Lin, I'm almost breaking through to the level of a human being. Is it serious?"
His hand held Lin Sui's arm again, looking very happy.
Lin Zui held her wrist and took her hand off her arm.
Lin Shihan was stunned for a moment.
She thought there were just outsiders, so she needed to keep a distance.
"Brother Lin?"
Lin Zui didn't look at her.
He took a half step back and opened the distance between the two of them.
Then he said, "Senior Sister Lin, you are an inner disciple and the successor of the Palace Master, and I am just a handyman disciple. We really shouldn't have too much contact between you and me."
Lin Shihan stood there, her face a little stiff, and her smile slowly disappeared.
"What did you say?" Her voice was very soft.
Lin Zui didn't answer.
He took out the cloth bag from his arms, opened it and took a look.
Inside were a few pills, the quality of which was much better than the Heqi pills, and several pieces of dried animal meat, with faint lines visible on the dried meat.
It's all good stuff.
He tied the cloth bag up again and handed it back.
"These resources are used by the sect to train you. They do not belong to me, so there is no need to give me anything."
"Brother Lin," Lin Shihan's voice was trembling, "Do you think I've caused you trouble? Don't you want me anymore?"
Lin Zui shook his head, his voice calm.
"Senior Sister Lin, just think of your past memories as being young and ignorant."
Lin Shihan's eyes were red, and tears fell from her eyes, leaving a wet mark on her cheeks.
"What's wrong with you? Are you still the Brother Lin I know?"
Lin Zui raised his head and looked at her.
She cried, extremely sad.
In his impression, this little girl had never cried.
Even in Anyang Village, when she was chased by a dog and her skin was scratched, she never cried.
But now, the person who made her cry was himself.
Lin Zui felt extremely distressed and almost reached out to wipe her tears.
But he didn't.
He looked into her eyes and spoke word by word.
"Senior Sister Lin, after more than half a month of training, you will be able to break through to the level of Immortal One Bone. As you can see, I am a rudimentary form of One Bone. I can't even feel the position of the Immortal Bone after practicing for half a month. It may take me twenty years, or even longer, for others to break through to the mortal world in ten years."
"Twenty years later, I'm afraid you will have cultivated to the level of Five-Bone Human Immortal. You may even change your destiny against the will of heaven, give birth to more immortal bones, live countless lives, stay young forever, and stand at a higher place."
